text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki brilliantly seized 1st place. 
Her rivals, too, praised her performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Running with her emotions laid bare is far 
better. It felt as though we got to know 
the real Yaeno Muteki a little more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tears welled up in Yaeno Muteki's eyes at 
those words. Running purely on her 
emotions felt so refreshing, and she 
wanted to keep running with everyone from 
now on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki revealed that gaining 
everyone's recognition helped her gain 
confidence in herself. And with that, she 
gave a blissful smile.
